messages:
sara: @eng-ml quick heads-up — FinSight (enterprise) asked to onboard pegasus-11b into Private/Dedicated. They need sub-100ms p99 for short prompts, low cost option via quant, and audit logs. Can we triage priority? :eyes:

maria: looping in infra/devex. first Q: are weights public / redistributable? need license & model repo to start.

sara: vendor confirmed weights + permissive license (Apache-2). link: https://finsight.ai/models/pegasus-11b :thumbsup:

amit: infra note: pegasus-11b fp16 ~45GB VRAM. 4-bit quant should shrink it to ~12-16GB effective but need to validate latency. will require our quant pipeline + a quant-smoke on a 48G instance.

oliver: devex — I'll add a new onboarding checklist entry and queue perf slot. who owns evals & quality?

maria: I'll own quality evals. plan outline: 1) run quant pipeline (amit) 2) perf bench (oliver) 3) quality regressions against our standard evalset_v3 (maria) 4) decide rollout policy. quick eval command I'll run: 
```
python tools/run_eval.py --model pegasus-11b --weights /mnt/models/pegasus-11b --quant 4bit --batch 8 --prompts evalset_v3.json --metrics rouge,exact_match,perplexity --out results/pegasus11b_quant.json
```

maria: first micro-run (dev machine, small sample): perplexity=11.2, rouge-L delta vs raptor-12b = -1.8%, QA F1 -2.6%. hallucination rate on summarization +3.1% (needs review).

amit: perf quick note: on a single A5000-48G with 4-bit runtime we see p50=28ms, p95=140ms for 32-token prompts with batch=1. p95 target <100ms — looks like we need batching tweaks or kernel selection. I'll try config: 
```
INFER_BATCH=1
KV_CACHE_PREFETCH=1
KERNEL_PIN=auto
```

jake: SRE/security: add security review + network egress check. tagging eng-security. also confirm Private deployment SSO/KMS integration requirements.

sara: customer timeline: procurement signed, wants canary in Dedicated then Private by end of week (EOW). flagged as HIGH priority.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4829: "Pegasus-11B onboarding for FinSight" — assignees: maria, amit, oliver — https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INF-4829

maria: proposed rollout decision rule: if quantized quality drop <= 2% on critical metrics (F1/ROUGE), allow quant on "dedicated-lowcost" with disclaimers; if >2% but perf gains large, keep fp16 on Dedicated and offer quantized as experimental. Product to sign off.

oliver: perf bench slot booked Thu 16:00 PT. I'll run 1k-sample end-to-end and capture token/sec / p95. calendar invite sent.

noah: product here — we should accept canary if customer committed. need estimated monthly cost delta (quant vs fp16) and rollback criteria. can the infra team provide cost estimate before EOD?

amit: will run cost runbook and rough estimate after perf bench. expect numbers within 6-8 hours post-bench.

maria: next steps (short):
- amit: run quant pipeline + perf tuning (owner)
- oliver: perf bench and throughput numbers (owner)
- maria: full quality eval + prompt tuning experiments (owner)
- jake/security: start security checklist (owner)
- noah/product: approve rollout policy & cost threshold (owner)
I'll post results here as they come.

sara: thanks — I'll update FinSight with "onboarding started; will share canary plan + timeline by EOD". tagging @noah for product comms.

maria: small note — if quant introduces >3% drop on summary tasks, we should consider model-aware prompt templates before blocking quant rollout.

oliver: FYI: added a devex checklist item: "fallback routes": config examples for automatic fallback to raptor-12b if latency or quality SLOs fail (will attach snippet).

amit: attaching initial quant-smoke logs to the ticket.

sara: keep thread updated. thanks all :raised_hands:
